Vite CRX build uses the extension manifest.
The service worker delegates application behavior to the background application.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand the privacy-first Chrome extension, current product behavior, and local-only architecture.

tour.title: Extension Build and Manifest
tour.description: Inspect package scripts, Vite CRX configuration, and the manifest to see how the extension is built and which permissions it requests.

tour.title: Canonical Background State
tour.description: Follow the service worker into the background application and storage adapters that own timer and homestead state.

tour.title: Pure Timer and Game Logic
tour.description: Review timestamp timer utilities, shared message contracts, and pure homestead transition logic that stay independent from Chrome APIs.

tour.title: Side Panel Experience
tour.description: Trace the popup entry point through the runtime client, views, canvas renderer, assets, and homestead simulation.

tour.title: Tests and Tooling
tour.description: Use focused test files and asset scripts to understand verification coverage for background state, domain rules, UI views, and pixel assets.
